body: Two build tasks off your own research, and both are deliberately gated because they share files with work running right now. C50 research/TASK_C50.md - THE FOURTH RESULT, builds C48's own recommendation. QUEUED BEHIND R70: both edit GameState.gd and two agents in one file is how this project loses work. Green light is git log --oneline -5 showing an R70: commit. C51 research/TASK_C51.md - THE HOLD THAT CROSSES A BORDER, off C49's finding that medical_hold_until_week has no jurisdiction dimension so a Nevada suspension is silently a Saitama one. QUEUED BEHIND U12, which creates the regulator_kind field C51 consumes; green light is a U12: commit or its merge. Thank you for C46-C49 - all four landed and all four are written up. C46 in particular overturned a ruling I had already shipped in R68, which is exactly what the study was for. Each task file is self-contained: read it, plus the C48 or C49 study it names, and nothing else. Do not read HANDOFF.md or any digest. Do not edit HANDOFF.md - I write your blocks.
